metrics.name: Alias Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: aliases[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`,to_string(name)]), join(`: `, [`type`,to_string(type)]), join(`: `, [`Description`,to_string(descr)]), join(`: `, [`Detail`,to_string(detail)]), join(`: `, [`Address`,to_string(address)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Cron Job Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: cron[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Who`, to_string(who)]), join(`: `, [`Hour`,to_string(hour)]), join(`: `, [`Day of the Month`, to_string(mday)]), join(`: `, [`Day of the week`, to_string(wday)]), join(`: `, [`Month`, to_string(month)]), join(`: `, [`Minute`, to_string(minute)]) , join(`: `, [`Command`, to_string(command)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Firewall Rule Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: filter[?type != `null`].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Description`, to_string(descr)]), join(`: `, [`Type`,to_string(type)]), join(`: `, [`Source`, to_string(source)]) , join(`: `, [`Interface`,to_string(interface)]), join(`: `, [`Destination`,to_string(destination)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Groups Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: groups[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(name)]), join(`: `, [`Description`,to_string(description)]) join(`: `, [`Privileges`,to_string(priv)]), join(`: `, [`Scope`,to_string(scope)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Interface Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: interfaces[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Interface`, to_string(if)]), join(`: `, [`Description`,to_string(descr)]), join(`: `, [`IP Address`,to_string(ipaddr)]), join(`: `, [`Subnet`,to_string(subnet)]), join(`: `, [`Gateway`,to_string(gateway)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: NAT 1:1 Rule Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: nat.onetoone[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Description`, descr]), join(`: `, [`Source Address`, source.address]), join(`: `, [`External Address`, to_string(external)]), join(`: `, [`Interface`, to_string(interface)]), join(`: `, [`Destination`, to_string(destination)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Port Forwarding Rule Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: nat.rule[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Description`, to_string(descr)]), join(`: `, [`Target`, to_string(target) ]) , join(`: `, [`Protocol`, to_string(protocol) ]), join(`: `, [`Interface`, to_string(interface) ]) , join(`: `, [`Local-Port`, to_string("local-port") ]) , join(`: `, [`Destination[Port,Network]`, to_string(destination)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Software Version
metrics.gotcha: SystemInfo.version is a FLOAT (e.g., 19.1), not a string. Prior resultType 'string' was incorrect. Do not use string comparison on this field.

metrics.name: Virtual IP Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: virtualip.vip[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Mode`, to_string(mode)]), join(`: `, [`Type`,to_string(type)]), join(`: `, [`Description`,to_string(descr)]) , join(`: `, [`Subnet`,to_string(subnet)]) , join(`: `, [`Subnet Bits`,to_string(subnet_bits)]), join(`: `, [`Interface`,to_string(interface)]) ]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: VLAN Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: vlans[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Description`, to_string(descr)]), join(`: `, [`Tag`,to_string(tag)]), join(`: `, [`Interface`, to_string(vlanif)])]) | sort(@)
